ai_summary_zh: 該區域包含廣泛的碎石路面，總面積約6498.8平方米。檢測到一個面積約277.0平方米的水體，其岸線高程為TWVD2001 +51.05米。未發現任何符合樹木定義的樹幹。
ai_summary_en: The area features extensive gravel road corridors, totaling approximately 6498.8 square meters. One water body, covering about 277.0 square meters with a shoreline elevation of TWVD2001 +51.05m, was identified. No tree trunks meeting the definition were found.
